What is the output of print(0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3) ?

Supplied answer
False, because floats are stored in binary and 0.1 + 0.2 is actually 0.30000000000000004. Compare
floats with a tolerance, for example abs(x - y) < 1e-9, or use the decimal module for money calculations.
